description: Roadmap data for special character groups, relationships and future encounter intent rules.

groups.notes: Hazak and Henrique are best friends. Hazak is also a strong leader and can make the encounter more dangerous depending on context.
The friendship group is Mattzelda, Louis and Trexof. It is usually a challenge or rivalry fight, not a death match by default.
Aoi protects her incantations, Kanadé complains but keeps going, Sanctus protects the group.
Hestia was once a divinity but lost her memories. Hazak saved her and avoids death matches when she is present.
Fail has a non-aggression contract with Hazak. Hazak tolerates the danger only as long as the contract still has meaning.
Skuro can appear with one compatible special character only: Hazak, Henrique, Aoi, Fail or Kanadé. His presence increases brutality.
Skuro can appear with two compatible special characters only, without duplicate. This is one of the most unstable group patterns.
Fire Flight leads like a commander. Matt (PRO) is silent, respectful and dangerous. Matt (PRO) can also appear alone outside this duo.
Normal random adventurer group. Names and races are random. No special character can appear here.

notes: Matt (PRO) can appear alone in AI combat and can also appear through the normal special arena draw.
Matt (PRO) does not talk directly: he fights silently and treats the opponent with respect.
Skuro can only appear with Hazak, Henrique, Aoi, Fail or Kanadé for now.
Sanctus and Skuro are the same person in the story. Sanctus can later transform into Skuro after taking or dealing a huge hit.
Skuro was born from Sanctus breaking after cutting his first head.

soloSpecials.notes: Available as a direct AI combat choice and also possible through special arena random draw.

triggerIdeas: takes huge damage in one hit
deals huge damage in one hit
futureTransformations.notes: Same person. Sanctus breaks into Skuro when the protective light fails or violence takes over.
